## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 9/11 sectors positive; Sector Strength on aggregate but mixed internals and major-cap divergences keep regime neutral. Confirmations: broad sector gains (Financials, Materials, Industrials ABOVE TREND) offset by large-cap Tech weakness and multiple major stocks in RECOVERY — Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5).

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Financials lead: JPM (1W: +5.90% | 1M: +11.19%) ABOVE TREND, COF (1W: +9.42% | 1M: +7.65%) ABOVE TREND; Materials strong: FCX (1W: +9.18% | 1M: +11.33%) ABOVE TREND, CRH (1W: +8.81% | 1M: +9.33%) ABOVE TREND. Industrials also strong: CAT (1W: +3.36% | 1M: +6.43%) ABOVE TREND, BA (1W: +6.05% | 1M: +3.17%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Energy lagging: XOM (1W: -4.73% | 1M: -10.17%) BELOW TREND, COP (1W: -4.67% | 1M: -9.04%) BELOW TREND. Healthcare soft on the week: JNJ (1W: -0.77% | 1M: +4.33%) CORRECTION, UNH (1W: -0.73% | 1M: +4.10%) CORRECTION. Tech internals mixed with marquee software names showing weakness (ADBE, ORCL, CRM) despite equipment strength.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: AMAT (1W: +13.83% | 1M: +30.30%) ABOVE TREND, LRCX (1W: +12.89% | 1M: +29.72%) ABOVE TREND, RCL (1W: +10.83% | 1M: +20.81%) ABOVE TREND, NEM (1W: +10.05% | 1M: -0.34%) RECOVERY, COF (1W: +9.42% | 1M: +7.65%) ABOVE TREND — Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5).

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: ADBE (1W: -12.85% | 1M: -16.27%) BELOW TREND, CRM (1W: -7.54% | 1M: -6.56%) BELOW TREND, ORCL (1W: -8.49% | 1M: -2.39%) BELOW TREND, INTU (1W: -4.35% | 1M: -28.50%) BELOW TREND, XOM (1W: -4.73% | 1M: -10.17%) BELOW TREND — Weakness concentrated in software and Energy.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Best 1W movers: AMAT (1W: +13.83% | 1M: +30.30%) ABOVE TREND, LRCX (1W: +12.89% | 1M: +29.72%) ABOVE TREND, RCL (1W: +10.83% | 1M: +20.81%) ABOVE TREND, NEM (1W: +10.05% | 1M: -0.34%) RECOVERY, COF (1W: +9.42% | 1M: +7.65%) ABOVE TREND — Note MAJOR divergence across mega-caps (≥3 majors in RECOVERY) — tactical risk until confirmed.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Mixed: Equipment names lead — AMAT (1W: +13.83% | 1M: +30.30%) ABOVE TREND, LRCX (1W: +12.89% | 1M: +29.72%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +8.46% | 1M: +7.61%) ABOVE TREND — but large software names lag: ADBE (1W: -12.85% | 1M: -16.27%) BELOW TREND, ORCL (1W: -8.49% | 1M: -2.39%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -2.37% | 1M: -6.46%) BELOW TREND. Internal rotation within Tech; monitor whether equipment-led strength broadens.

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Clear strength: JPM (1W: +5.90% | 1M: +11.19%) ABOVE TREND, V (1W: +2.48% | 1M: +2.26%) ABOVE TREND, MA (1W: +1.23% | 1M: +1.44%) ABOVE TREND, COF (1W: +9.42% | 1M: +7.65%) ABOVE TREND — Financials are a reliable source of breadth and are confirming the market’s cyclical tilt.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Cautious tone: PFE (1W: +1.32% | 1M: +2.80%) ABOVE TREND, but JNJ (1W: -0.77% | 1M: +4.33%) CORRECTION and UNH (1W: -0.73% | 1M: +4.10%) CORRECTION indicate short-term profit-taking; LLY (1W: -1.94% | 1M: +11.70%) CORRECTION — sector showing mixed defensive positioning.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor cyclical/value exposure given breadth and leadership (JPM (1W: +5.90% | 1M: +11.19%) ABOVE TREND, CAT (1W: +3.36% | 1M: +6.43%) ABOVE TREND, FCX (1W: +9.18% | 1M: +11.33%) ABOVE TREND). Reduce exposure to structurally weak software/high-multiple names showing BELOW TREND (ADBE, ORCL, CRM) and monitor RECOVERY names for confirmation.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: AMAT (1W: +13.83% | 1M: +30.30%) ABOVE TREND, LRCX (1W: +12.89% | 1M: +29.72%) ABOVE TREND, COF (1W: +9.42% | 1M: +7.65%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: ADBE (1W: -12.85% | 1M: -16.27%) BELOW TREND, ORCL (1W: -8.49% | 1M: -2.39%) BELOW TREND, INTU (1W: -4.35% | 1M: -28.50%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Financials, Materials, Industrials (9/11 sectors positive is supporting cyclical outperformance). BEARISH: Energy and select Healthcare names that showed profit-taking this week.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
Watch whether NVDA (1W: -0.37% | 1M: -7.84%) BELOW TREND can reclaim its 1M trend to resume leadership; AAPL (1W: +2.99% | 1M: -0.33%) RECOVERY holding weekly gains is a confirmation trigger; JPM (1W: +5.90% | 1M: +11.19%) sustaining ABOVE TREND would signal continued Financials-led breadth.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
ACN (+55): Accenture lands AI/Unilever deal — ACN (1W: -4.58% | 1M: -1.95%) BELOW TREND; news is bullish but price is diverging, watch for follow-through. TXN (+75): analog demand lift reported — TXN not in detailed returns here but headline is constructive for Tech equipment/value cyclicals; monitor sector peers AMAT/LRCX for confirmation. ABBV (+80): strong operational beat per headlines — ABBV not in the detailed table here but the news suggests Healthcare re-rating risk to the upside; cross-check price action before adding exposure.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
INTU (-60): Goldman downgrade cited — INTU (1W: -4.35% | 1M: -28.50%) BELOW TREND and news confirms deterioration. ORCL (-45): reported cloud deal loss headline — ORCL (1W: -8.49% | 1M: -2.39%) BELOW TREND confirming negative sentiment. ADBE (news pressure via general AI concerns): ADBE (1W: -12.85% | 1M: -16.27%) BELOW TREND — sentiment and price are aligned.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, Value/Cyclical style given broad Financials/Materials/Industrials leadership. JPM (1W: +5.90% | 1M: +11.19%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +13.83% | 1M: +30.30%) ABOVE TREND and LRCX (1W: +12.89% | 1M: +29.72%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk: MAJOR divergence among mega-cap Techs in RECOVERY (AAPL, GOOGL, META, AMZN, TSLA) and concentrated software weakness (ADBE, ORCL, CRM) — watch for confirmation before adding cyclicals to core.
